title: ItemUpdatedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'item.updated'. Emitted when an existing catalog_items row (or a satellite/provenance field belonging to it) changes — rescans, provider refreshes, and editorial edits alike (docs/PLAN.md §4.3, §8.1).

changedFields.description: Names of the fields that changed on this item (e.g. 'title', 'overview', 'communityRating').
